subject: Variant rollout blocker: Nova-3x incompatibility and roadmap tradeoffs
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Model Platform <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Product Onboarding <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Variant rollout blocker: Nova-3x incompatibility and roadmap tradeoffs

Hi team,

Heads-up — during last night's staged rollout of Nova-3x (variant v3.0.1) we started seeing a class of failures for requests with long, multi-turn chats that use function-calling. Failure mode is intermittent KV-cache misses that manifest as 500s from the serving runtime. Attached is an initial compatibility report and latency delta CSV.

Acme AI (who's on the canary) flagged this this morning and are pausing their rollout. They're asking for a firm mitigation plan and an expected ETA. Given commercial timelines we need a short-term exception to keep them on a supported model path while we remediate, or a clear fallback we can enforce from the routing layer.

Ask: can Model Platform evaluate whether we can: 1) pin Acme's tenant to Nova-2s (previous variant) programmatically for 14 days as a temporary mitigation, or 2) enable an automated fallback (region-level) to Nova-2s when cache miss rate crosses threshold?

What I need from each of you by EOD tomorrow:
- Karthik: technical assessment of root cause, feasibility of a tenant-level pin or routing-based fallback, and rough ETA for a code / configuration fix. Include perf delta and expected impact on SLOs.
- Laura: product guidance on acceptable exception window and comms template for Acme.
- Vivek: legal/enterprise implications if we ship a temporary exception (I know you own those escalations).

Attachments: nova-3x-compat-report.pdf (sample traces + repro steps), latency-deltas.csv (staging vs prod), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (initial draft).

I know this is tight — I'm marking this high priority because Acme is in the paid canary and they've threatened to roll back to their own hosted weights if we don't provide a stable path.

Thanks,

--
Chloe Martin
Technical Program Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Product Onboarding <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Variant rollout blocker: Nova-3x incompatibility and roadmap tradeoffs

Thanks for the flag and the artifacts, Chloe. Quick read-through notes below.

- Initial hypothesis: the KV-cache eviction and the newer attention kernel in Nova-3x interact poorly for sequences >2048 tokens; we see cache churn and occasional desync. That matches the traces in the report.
- Tenant-level pin: technically feasible if we implement a routing override for Acme (route their traffic to Nova-2s until we flip). That is a config + routing rule change and can be rolled in <24 hours if we prioritize it.
- Automated fallback: doable but riskier — we'd need to add a runtime signal for cache-miss percent that triggers an immediate routing change; safe implementation for that would take 3–4 days including load testing.
- Full fix: kernel change + cache handling update likely 2–3 sprints (4–6 weeks) depending on priority.

I will:
1) Run a quick canary with workload-slim that forces long sequences to reproduce and validate the tenant-pin approach.
2) Prepare a short MOP for Ops to apply the tenant-level override (will include a revert plan).
3) Sketch fallback signal thresholds and failure modes so Product can choose acceptable tradeoffs.

Chloe — if we do the tenant-pin route, we should simultaneously enable request-level logging for Acme to validate the mitigation and measure any latency impact. I will attach a tentative MOP to that effect by EOD.

-Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Variant rollout blocker: Nova-3x incompatibility and roadmap tradeoffs

Appreciate the quick triage. A few product / commercial notes:

- Acme is on a committed Dedicated plan and expects production parity; we should treat this as an SLA-impacting incident from their perspective.
- Exception window: Product recommends a maximum of 14 calendar days for any manual tenant pin without an approval loop. Anything longer needs a formal change request and Exec approval.

Options for comms to Acme (draft bullet points):
1) We are pausing Nova-3x for your tenant and routing you to Nova-2s to ensure stability while we remediate.
2) Estimated mitigation ETA: tenant pin applied within 24h; deeper remediation 4–6 weeks.
3) We will provide daily progress updates and telemetry for your review; if we cannot restore parity within 14 days we will discuss credits/compensation.

Operational ask: Karthik, please call out any SLO regressions we should include in the comms (p95 latency, token cost).

Also: can we use the routing override to gate billing so Acme is not billed for transient errors? Finance will need to review. Vivek — please advise on acceptable credit language and whether we need legal sign-off on the template.

-Laura

Subject: Re: Variant rollout blocker: Nova-3x incompatibility and roadmap tradeoffs

Thanks all — quick status:

- Karthik ran the workload-slim canary and validated that a tenant-level routing override will stop the 500s. Ops MOP attached. We'll apply the override for Acme tonight and monitor for 48h.
- Karthik's perf note: expected p95 latency increase from Nova-2s is ~90ms for long sequences, token cost delta ~+8%.
- Laura: we'll use your 14-day window and send the drafted comms; included a line about credits if we miss the 14-day remediation commitment.
- Vivek: please confirm if legal needs to sign the comms, otherwise we'll send to Acme PM this evening.

I've attached the signed Mutual Action Plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) with the temporary routing decision and rollback criteria. DocuSign link for the amendment: https://app.docusign.com/doc/XYZ-123

I'll post a short post-mortem doc to the Nova-3x confluence page after we have 48h of monitoring.
